query:
UPDATE media_attachments
               SET description = COALESCE($2, description),
                   file_meta = CASE WHEN $3::jsonb IS NULL THEN file_meta
                       ELSE jsonb_set(COALESCE(file_meta::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), '{focus}', $3::jsonb)::json END,
                   updated_at = now()
               WHERE id = $1
